basic_details.scholarship_name: King Faisal University International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & King Faisal University (KFU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Faisal University Main Campus (Al-Ahsa Oasis, Eastern Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to Computer Science and Information Technology, Agricultural and Food Sciences, Veterinary Medicine, Engineering, Science, Business Administration, Education, and Arts (Medical clinical colleges reserved for Saudi nationals).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 300 government scholarships awarded annually to international students
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open bilateral competition; Pakistani scholars represent a major national group (~25 to 45 awards annually across computing, agriculture, and engineering)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD (plus 1-year Arabic preparation if necessary)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years of age; Master's applicants under 30; PhD applicants under 35 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Intermediate (HSSC) / A-Levels with at least 80% aggregate for Bachelor's; recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree for Master's; 18-year Master's degree for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Evaluated on Saudi 5.0 grading scale; equivalent to minimum 3.75 / 5.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS for Computer Science and Engineering; Pre-Medical for Agricultural Sciences, Food Science, and Veterinary Medicine.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have completed secondary or tertiary education with official final transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school graduation certificate must not exceed 3 to 5 years from application date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; prior laboratory or research exposure beneficial for graduate applicants.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: English is the medium of instruction in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, and Agricultural Sciences (MOI certificate accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). Arabic proficiency required for humanities and Islamic studies.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Free Arabic language training provided at KFU Language Center.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female international students must reside in monitored university residential housing or with an officially recognized legal Mahram in Saudi Arabia.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Submitted via unified 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent Saudi government scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition exemption for the complete official degree duration.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 45,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 3,375,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Application via 'Study in Saudi' portal is completely free.

accommodation.details: Free furnished on-campus student housing in KFU student residence halls in Al-Ahsa, including air-conditioned rooms, Wi-Fi, utilities, and sports facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend paid directly by the university: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~USD 224; ~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 to 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~USD 240 to 266; ~PKR 67,500 to 75,000 / month).

airfare.details: Free annual economy-class round-trip flight ticket between Pakistan and Dammam/Al-Ahsa provided at the conclusion of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Official Saudi student visa issued free of charge through the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive 100% free healthcare provided at King Faisal University Health Center and affiliated government hospitals.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus meals served in university cafeterias for SAR 3 to 6 per meal; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to KFU Central Library, scientific electronic databases, and laboratory research facilities; initial book allowance provided upon arrival.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Postgraduate thesis printing subsidy (SAR 3,000 for Master's, SAR 4,000 for PhD) and financial awards for publishing in high-impact ISI/Scopus journals.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university campus shuttle transport between student dormitories and academic colleges.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (King Faisal University, Al-Ahsa)
participating_institutions: King Faisal University (KFU) Main Campus (Al-Ahsa, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS Arab Region #45, Times Higher Education Asia #151-200, global leader in Agricultural Sciences, Food Security, and Water Engineering.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 to 5 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online registration on 'Study in Saudi' portal, high school or university transcripts with minimum 80% / 3.0 CGPA, valid passport copy, police character certificate, medical fitness report, and two academic recommendation letters.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Agricultural and Food Sciences have world-class research facilities and strong funding quotas; Computer Science and Engineering have high applicant volumes from South Asia.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure educational documents are verified by IBCC or HEC and attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) before uploading to the portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Portal & KFU Deanship of Admissions
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the 'Study in Saudi' system, choose 'External Scholarship', specify King Faisal University, select degree program, and upload color document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application window on studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa (typically opens September/October).
Step 2: Complete profile registration, enter educational qualifications and percentages.
Step 3: Upload color scans of passport, educational certificates, transcripts, police report, and medical clearance.
Step 4: Select King Faisal University and arrange desired programs in order of preference.
Step 5: Submit application online without application fee and retain application tracking reference.
Step 6: KFU admissions board screens applications and submits candidate nominations to the Ministry of Education (December - March).
Step 7: Final approvals granted by Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (May - July).
Step 8: Admission confirmation and visa authorization issued on the portal.
Step 9: Complete visa processing at Gerry's / Etimad in Pakistan, obtain university-booked flight ticket, and travel to Saudi Arabia in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Admission and full scholarship are processed concurrently through the 'Study in Saudi' system.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as scanned PDF documents on institutional letterhead signed by referees.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement explaining motivation for studying at King Faisal University and how the chosen discipline aligns with future career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For postgraduate applicants: 3 to 5-page research plan detailing problem statement, proposed methodology, and expected outcomes.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing educational trajectory, skills, and extracurricular activities.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No oral interview; selection based purely on document evaluation and Ministry verification.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Not required for international external applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by IBCC / HEC, MoFA Pakistan, and the Saudi Cultural Mission / Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic or English translation required for documents in other languages.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete high school (Intermediate/A-Levels) or degree certificates and grade sheets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC or HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of passport info page with at least 18 months remaining validity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must be valid through late 2027 or 2028.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical examination report certifying freedom from communicable diseases.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Conducted at a recognized diagnostic laboratory and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official certificate confirming no criminal convictions issued within the last 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Written appraisals from academic teachers or professors endorsing character and competence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official school/college letterhead with contact details.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official birth certificate or NADRA Family Registration Certificate (FRC).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA computerized certificate in English attested by MoFA.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake cycle aligned with the Saudi national 'Study in Saudi' academic admissions calendar.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: King Faisal University Admissions Board and Saudi Ministry of Education Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Academic ranking followed by governmental security clearance and visa allocation.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000 to 15,000 international applicants across all disciplines
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% for applicants with top-tier academic scores (85%+)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 85%+ in Intermediate (FSc/ICS) or CGPA 3.30+ / 4.00 from an HEC-recognized university
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High academic grades, strong discipline, clean record, and demonstrated enthusiasm for studying in Saudi Arabia.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of reputable colleges and universities across Pakistan.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Jordan, Bangladesh, Sudan, India.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized consultancy websites promising guaranteed KFU admissions for fees.
Applications are processed exclusively through studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa and kfu.edu.sa without any fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for the scholarship is 100% free of charge; do not pay any agent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: King Faisal University does not authorize recruitment agencies or private intermediaries.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Attestation fees in Pakistan (IBCC/HEC and MoFA): ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Consular attestation and biometric visa processing fees at Gerry's/Etimad: ~PKR 20,000 to 30,000.
Medical diagnostics at an approved clinic: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You cannot study computer science or agriculture in English. Reality: KFU delivers computing, engineering, and agricultural disciplines in English.
Myth: Scholarship covers family living expenses. Reality: The scholarship covers only the individual student; bringing dependents requires separate personal financial sponsorship.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim paper documents must be mailed to Al-Ahsa; only online applications through 'Study in Saudi' are accepted.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.00; failing to maintain Good standing leads to academic warning and stipend suspension.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Minimum 75% attendance in all courses; exceeding 25% unexcused absence results in course deprivation (Hirman).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress evaluated by the Deanship of Admissions; studies must be completed within standard degree limits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Students must depart Saudi Arabia upon completion of studies unless transitioning to approved employment or higher graduate study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No bond or mandatory service agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship revoked if the student is expelled for disciplinary misconduct or unexcused withdrawal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: University transfers are prohibited under external scholarship terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change permitted only within the same college during the first academic year subject to GPA requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one semester granted in exceptional circumstances upon faculty recommendation.
